verdicts.reason: A is unusable. The headline block and photo have shrunk to a postage stamp near the bottom middle, there are stray yellow tick marks at top left, an empty frame and a cut-off yellow bar at the right, and the rest of the banner is blank. B is simply the original shrunk into the centre of the banner, with huge empty white areas on both sides and tiny headline text. The yellow strip is clipped at the top and the thin frame is misaligned, but the design is at least intact and recognisable.
